brief:
Hamas and the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine held discussions on broadening national participation and upcoming electoral requirements, Shehab Wire reported. The two factions exchanged positions on mechanisms for widening Palestinian political engagement and reviewed procedures related to scheduled electoral processes. The talks underscored continuing efforts by Palestinian political movements to coordinate positions on governance and representation.

The specific proposals discussed and any joint conclusions reached were not disclosed in available reports. The meeting reflects an ongoing pattern of dialogue among Palestinian factions on questions of electoral participation and the structure of future national consultations.
